The '''glass blacksmith's puzzle''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' found in the [[Kin's Store Room]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|4}}

==Appearance==
The ''ter'angreal'' has an unspecified appearance of a blacksmith's puzzle made of glass. It is heavy, and when dropped broke a chip off the edge of a cistern cover.{{ref/book|8|4}}

==Use==
The use of this ''ter'angreal'' is unknown. [[Elayne]] tried testing it with a touch of Spirit, but it left her extremely dizzy and kept her from sleeping for half the night.{{ref/book|8|20}}
